hook: Machine learning predicts Arctic ocean mixing from routine data, 75% within a factor of 2 of observed.
hook_turn: 75% within a factor of 2 of observed.

readout.label: Predictions within factor of 2 of observations

summary: Direct turbulence measurements in the Arctic are scarce, so models rely on rough rules. The authors trained decision trees on over 5,000 global turbulence profiles to predict mixing from temperature and salinity, and tested them on held-out regions. The results differ clearly from a widely used scheme, but Arctic accuracy is judged against few direct observations.
title: Data‐Driven Parameterization of Arctic Ocean Turbulent Mixing
